CheckTitle: Ensure CloudTrail trails are integrated with CloudWatch Logs
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that each trail delivers to CloudWatch Logs and has delivered within the last 24 hours.
Risk: Without CloudWatch Logs integration, the section 4 metric-filter alarms cannot work and real-time detection is impossible.

Recommendation.Text: Configure the trail to send events to a CloudWatch Logs log group with an appropriate IAM role.

Notes: CIS AWS 1.x/2.0 control 3.4, removed from the 3.0 numbering (prerequisite for section 4); mapped to 3.1.
